steps.eval: (window.T = { repo: location.pathname.replace(/dist\/page\/index.html$/, ''), at: (r) => T.repo + r, dir: (p) => p.slice(0, p.lastIndexOf('/')), open: (r, mode = 'tab', heading = null) => window.mdbRemote.open({ path: T.at(r), root: T.dir(T.at(r)), heading, mode }).then((x) => x.result), labels: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab .tab-label')].map((t) => t.textContent), active: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains('active')), state: () => ({ labels: T.labels(), active: T.active(), title: document.title }) }) && [document.querySelector('.tabbar').hidden, document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').length]

steps.eval: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.tabbar').getBoundingClientRect(); const a = document.querySelector('.tab.active').getBoundingClientRect(); return [document.querySelectorAll('.tab').length, Math.round(a.left) >= Math.round(bar.left), Math.round(a.right) <= Math.round(bar.right), Math.round(document.querySelector('.tab').getBoundingClientRect().width)] })()
